notes.title: Update has just been released
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

We are happy to announce that our updated version of Crazy Belts just went live!

First of all many thanks for all your valuable feedback we listened very carefully to and that is a very vital part of this new updated version.

The following features have been updated and newly added:

- Integration of windowsed/fullscreen mode
- Possibility to select your resolution
- Minor bug fixes
- Steam Libraries updated


Big thanks to our development partner Jemchicomac and all players who made this updated version possible, you all rock!
